content: Holdings of equity ETFs SPY, XIU.TO, QQQ, ESGV (security, CUSIP, sector, weight)
source: State Street SSGA (SPY); iShares Canada (XIU); SEC N-PORT (QQQ series S000101292, ESGV series S000063075); GICS sectors: AlphaForge universe, iShares, Wikipedia S&P 500 list
coverage: SPY and XIU as of 2026-11-12; QQQ as of 2026-06-30; ESGV as of 2026-08-31 (latest N-PORT filed)
processing: scripts/etf_holdings.py: equities only; N-PORT tickers found by CUSIP via the SPY file; GOOG merged into GOOGL; XIU suffixed .TO
limitations: CURRENT holdings applied to all dates (not historical); current GICS sectors; ~10% of ESGV weight and ~5% of QQQ without a sector; bonds and GLD not decomposed
terms_of_use: SEC: public domain; SSGA and iShares: public access, cite the source; Wikipedia: CC BY-SA

content: Presence of each parent-fund holding in an ESG fund of the same market: SPY vs ESGV; XIU vs XCSR (ESG Leaders) and XESG (ESG Focus)
source: Derived from etf_holdings.csv + iShares Canada (XCSR, XESG); S&P 500 addition dates: Wikipedia
coverage: SPY/XIU/XCSR/XESG as of 2026-11-12; ESGV as of 2026-08-31
processing: scripts/esg_index_screen.py: match by ticker (GOOG→GOOGL, FOX→FOXA...), fallback on issuer (CUSIP-6); added to the S&P 500 after the ESGV date → undetermined_recent_addition
limitations: The holdings say WHO is excluded, not WHY (activity, controversy, ESG rating, diversity, universe). Word it as "excluded from the X index", never "fails ESG". XESG is optimized (keeps almost everything); XCSR also keeps the best ESG ratings by sector
terms_of_use: SEC: public domain; iShares: public access, cite the source; Wikipedia: CC BY-SA

content: Reported financials per company, metric, period and filing (revenue, profit, EPS, cash flow, balance sheet)
source: SEC EDGAR XBRL company facts: 10-K / 10-Q (us-gaap) and 40-F / 6-K (us-gaap or ifrs-full) filings
coverage: 18 SEC filers of the universe: RY, TD, MFC, ENB, CNQ, CNR, FTS, SHOP (Canadian) and AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, AMZN, TSLA, JPM, JNJ, PG, XOM; facts filed from 2019-01-23 to 2026-11-06
frequency: Annual and quarterly (point-in-time: one row per filing)
currency: Reporting currency of each company (USD or CAD), never converted
processing: scripts/ingest_fundamentals.py: full-year (annual forms) and stand-alone quarter durations and balance-sheet instants; year-to-date figures dropped; first available tag per metric (us-gaap, then ifrs-full); every filing kept with its filed date
limitations: No data for non-SEC filers (ATD, CSU); XOM has only recent quarters in the source; banks and insurers have no gross profit or capex and are not comparable with industrials; fiscal years are not calendar-aligned; no valuation multiples
terms_of_use: SEC EDGAR: public domain; send a contact e-mail in the User-Agent, at most 10 requests per second
